findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_use_cases, get_use_case, list_case_studies · Private data: find_use_cases · Public sink: find_use_cases.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_use_cases, get_use_case, list_case_studies · Private data: find_use_cases · Public sink: find_use_cases

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
